alt: A bearded bartender strains a pale cocktail from a copper shaker into a coupe glass on a marble bar lit from below by a warm amber glow.
A silhouetted pedestrian with a backpack walks past an arched shop window filled with vertical cyan light tubes on a dark cobbled street.
A lone visitor walks through a dim gallery with teal-blue walls hung with small framed photographs, reflected in the glossy black floor.
A hand holds a smartphone in total darkness, the screen casting a faint blue glow across the fingers.
A small unlabelled glass bottle on a dark ledge stands in silhouette against a glowing orange disc of light.
Looking down a spiral staircase with teal carpeted steps and a curving handrail, warm light glowing at the bottom of the stairwell.
Street vendors in face masks tend a long satay grill as flames and smoke rise into the night air.
Abstract streaks of teal, red and orange light blur diagonally across a black background.
